FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Premier Flooring Solutions, we specialize in professional installation of residential carpet, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring. Our operations focus solely on non-toxic, pre-manufactured flooring materials, ensuring that we do not disturb any hazardous materials such as asbestos or lead during our installations. We prioritize safety and quality by maintaining a documented safety program and providing regular training for our employees on installation techniques and equipment use. All our employees are covered by workers’ compensation and we adhere to strict licensing requirements across all jurisdictions we serve. We are committed to delivering exceptional service while upholding the highest standards of safety and compliance.

Our flooring installation services often involve removing old carpets and coverings that may contain hazardous materials such as asbestos or lead before installing new products.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We focus solely on non-toxic, pre-manufactured flooring materials and adhere to strict safety and compliance standards.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not sponsor any athletic teams as our focus is solely on flooring installation services. We prioritize maintaining our resources and compliance within our industry.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are verified to ensure proper coverage and mitigate any potential risks.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Premier Flooring Solutions has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical practices in all our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Premier Flooring Solutions has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. Our operations comply with all insurance requirements and industry standards.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain a direct employment relationship with our staff to ensure consistent quality and adherence to safety standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not have any workers' compensation coverage for installation or disturbance of hazardous materials such as asbestos or lead, which is a requirement for our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not own or operate any other business. Our focus remains solely on the installation of non-toxic flooring materials.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. All coverage considerations are focused on our core flooring installation operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Premier Flooring Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus exclusively on the installation of pre-manufactured, non-toxic flooring materials.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others, ensuring that all operations remain focused and compliant with safety standards.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Premier Flooring Solutions has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years and maintains a solid financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as we exclusively work with non-toxic, pre-manufactured flooring materials and adhere to strict safety standards.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not engage in any activities that would expose them to catastrophe risks, such as the installation or disturbance of hazardous materials. They focus solely on non-toxic, pre-manufactured flooring materials and adhere to strict safety protocols.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Premier Flooring Solutions does not have any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a commitment to ethical practices and a safe working environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: Yes – There are no uncorrected fire code violations.
